headline: Dollar strength sends won-dollar rate soaring into the 1,380s... stocks and bonds calm as 'rate hikes priced in'
summary: The won-dollar rate rose into the 1,380 range as a US benchmark rate hike strengthened the dollar. Stock and bond markets showed limited reaction, as the impact of the hike had already been priced in.
why: The won's exchange rate affects import costs and the returns of foreign investors in Korean assets.
why_moved: A US rate hike strengthened the dollar, pushing the won weaker against it in the week to the 17th.
